note: Business questions Store 014's 21 tables cannot answer. N = no answer at all, P = only a rough proxy. test = one of the four test questions.

items.question: How many shoppers left without a 5 kg atta?
items.why_not: Nothing records a shopper who did not buy. The only stockout signal is 3 “empty” audit snapshots.
items.would_answer_it: A footfall counter plus a “looked, did not buy” signal, or a shelf camera

items.question: What were the lost sales of any product?
items.why_not: Sales are cut off by stock: a day with no stock shows zero, not demand. The forecast is an average of recorded sales, so it is a guess, not demand.
items.would_answer_it: Hours of stock-out per product from continuous shelf sensing, plus a demand model

items.question: What would sales have been without any stockout (true demand)?
items.why_not: Same reason: the sales history already contains the gaps.

items.question: How many hours in June was each product off the shelf?
items.why_not: Audits are twice a week at 11:00, so stockouts between them are invisible. Book stock can be positive while the shelf is empty.
items.would_answer_it: A shelf sensor or hourly audit

items.question: When a product was empty, what did the shopper buy instead?
items.why_not: Bills carry no customer and no “wanted” item.
items.would_answer_it: A customer id on bills, or a “first choice” prompt

items.question: How many people visited the store each day?
items.why_not: No door counter. Bills are only the people who bought.

items.question: What share of visitors bought something?
items.why_not: Needs footfall.

items.question: How many shoppers abandoned a basket at the till?
items.why_not: No record of a basket that was not paid for.

items.question: Of shoppers whose UPI payment declined or failed, how many gave up?
items.why_not: Payment attempts are listed per bill, but a shopper who left cannot be told apart from one who paid another way.

items.question: Who are our best customers?
items.why_not: No customer id, loyalty number, phone or payer id on bills or UPI records.
items.would_answer_it: A loyalty id or payer-id capture

items.question: How often do customers come back?
items.why_not: Same: no customer id.

items.question: What is a customer worth over time?
items.why_not: Same, and too short a history.
items.would_answer_it: A customer id and a longer history

items.question: Which kinds of customer buy what?
items.why_not: No demographics or segment.

items.question: Do the same shoppers buy atta, oil and dal together?
items.why_not: Bills show which items go together, but only for these 11 products, and not who bought them.
items.would_answer_it: A customer id and the full range

items.question: How satisfied are customers?
items.why_not: Only 26 complaints, all about payments. Nothing about satisfaction.
items.would_answer_it: A survey, NPS or a review feed

items.question: Why did a shopper choose another store?
items.why_not: No competitor or reason data.

items.question: What is the store's market share in its area?
items.why_not: One store, no market data.

items.question: How much does a price change move demand?
items.why_not: Every product has one price for the whole period, so there is no change to learn from.
items.would_answer_it: A recorded price history with changes

items.question: Did a promotion work?
items.why_not: No promotions, discounts or coupons are recorded.
items.would_answer_it: A promotion calendar and discount lines

items.question: What price would earn the most profit for each product?
items.why_not: Needs to know how demand moves with price.

items.question: How do our prices compare with other stores?
items.why_not: No competitor prices.

items.question: Should expiring milk be marked down, and by how much?
items.why_not: Write-offs show expired stock but there are no markdowns and no sales by use-by date.
items.would_answer_it: Markdown records and stock by use-by date

items.question: Do customers see us as cheap or expensive?
items.why_not: No perception data.

items.question: Is Store 014 profitable?
items.why_not: Only product cost: no rent, wages, power or other overheads.
items.would_answer_it: A store profit and loss account

items.question: What is the gross margin on each product?
items.why_not: Margin can be worked out from one price and one cost per product, but real purchase cost, rebates and freight are not recorded.

items.question: What does each stockout cost us?
items.why_not: Needs the lost sales (question 2).

items.question: What does holding stock cost?
items.why_not: No stock value by period, no cost of capital, no space cost.

items.question: How much is stolen, and how much is just counted wrong?
items.why_not: Write-offs are only “damaged” and “expired”, and stock-count corrections have no cause.

items.question: What does a cash, UPI or card payment each cost us?
items.why_not: Only the UPI fee appears. There is no card fee and no cost of handling cash.

items.question: What are our payment terms with suppliers, and our working capital?
items.why_not: No invoices, payables or credit terms.

items.question: Which product deserves more shelf space for its profit?
items.why_not: No shelf space, facings or planogram.

items.question: How is a whole category doing, such as snacks or drinks?
items.why_not: Only 11 products.

items.question: Does a new product take sales from an old one?
items.why_not: No launches, and only 11 items.

items.question: Which products should we add or drop?
items.why_not: Needs demand and margin data beyond 11 items.

items.question: Do shoppers prefer brands or private label?
items.why_not: No brand or label on the product list.

items.question: Does the 5 kg pack sell at the expense of the 1 kg pack?
items.why_not: Sales exist for both, but there is no true demand and no shopper.
items.would_answer_it: A customer id plus demand data

items.question: How many staff do we need each hour?
items.why_not: No roster, headcount or tasks.

items.question: How long do customers queue at the till?
items.why_not: Bills have a time, but not when the queue began.
items.would_answer_it: A queue sensor or till wait time

items.question: How productive is each cashier?
items.why_not: No cashier or till id on bills.

items.question: When is the shelf restocked, and how long does it take?
items.why_not: No restocking records. Only the audit snapshots.

items.question: Why was the shelf empty: a late truck, a short pick, a missed restock, theft?
items.why_not: The stock files show trucks, picks and counts, but nothing ties an empty shelf to a cause.
items.would_answer_it: A cause code at each stockout

items.question: How good are the audits themselves?
items.why_not: One status per product per audit: no auditor, method or photo.
items.would_answer_it: An auditor id and a photo

items.question: Is the store layout working?
items.why_not: No layout, heat-map or path data.

items.question: Is the till or staff behaviour causing the double charges?
items.why_not: The 26 complaints show the symptom but not the cause inside the till.

items.question: Which supplier is best on price, quality and reliability?
items.why_not: No supplier name or price. Only the dairy and bakery routes and the warehouse trucks.

items.question: How accurate is the forecast against real demand?
items.why_not: The forecast can only be checked against sales, which stockouts have cut short.

items.question: Were the fresh products safe and cold in transit?
items.why_not: Fresh deliveries show crates and a use-by date, not temperature.

items.question: Which batch of a product had a quality problem?
items.why_not: No batch or lot number anywhere.
items.would_answer_it: A batch number on pallet and bill

items.question: How much does a delivery cost per case or per pallet?
items.why_not: No transport cost.

items.question: What is the carbon footprint of our deliveries?
items.why_not: No distance, fuel or vehicle detail.

items.question: How reliable is the warehouse beyond June?
items.why_not: June only.

items.question: Which customers were double-charged, and will they come back?
items.why_not: Complaints have a bill and a payment reference but no customer, and no later behaviour.

items.question: How much fraud is there?
items.why_not: No fraud flag or dispute data beyond refunds.

items.question: Why do shoppers pick cash, card or UPI?
items.why_not: The payment type is recorded, the reason is not.

items.question: Does the cash in the till match the cash banked?
items.why_not: No cash deposit or till count records.

items.question: What did the customer's bank show for a failed payment?
items.why_not: The records are the store's and the provider's, not the customer's account.
items.would_answer_it: Bank statements, from outside the store

list.group: Outside the store, and over time

items.question: How do weather, festivals or local events change sales?
items.why_not: No external data, and only 8 weeks.

items.question: What will sales be at Diwali?
items.why_not: No earlier years, no seasons.

items.question: What is the year-on-year trend?
items.why_not: Under two months of till lines.

items.question: How does Store 014 compare with other stores?
items.why_not: One store.

items.question: Where should the next store go?
items.why_not: No catchment, population, rent or competitor data.

items.question: Will a shelf camera or a new system pay for itself?
items.why_not: Needs the lost sales, the costs and a baseline.
items.would_answer_it: The data for question 2, plus costs

items.question: Do we comply with food-safety and labelling rules?
items.why_not: No inspection, label or use-by data beyond fresh deliveries.
